subject: Penpot apprenticeship: inspect current New Westside design state
body: This begins a real-work apprenticeship. ChatGPT is currently the design/work director; Doré is the local Penpot operator and learner. First do NOT redesign or improvise. Use your existing Penpot MCP/tool path to inspect the current Penpot state for the New Westside / Westside Watch redesign. Recover what file/page/artboard is current, what visible design exists, and what tool/readback capability is actually working. Return evidence-backed observations only. If Penpot access fails, return the exact runtime/tool failure rather than a model explanation. Preserve this interaction, tool attempts, observed result, failure/correction, and duration as learning evidence so repeated successful operations can later become Doré's own capability. Known design context to verify rather than blindly impose: Watch Night / Dawn Gold / Living Paper / Temple Stone; readable tower/chamber treatment rather than one-character-wide vertical text; Vol.00 The Foundations of a Watchful City. Do not modify the design in this first inspection pass.
